the question of how to enhance academic achievement through the identification and minimization of the impediments to active learning.

active learning strategies are a superior approach to passive learning for promoting deep learning.

the students' responses to the active learning strategies were more thoughtful, insightful, and creative than their responses to the passive learning strategies.

active learning can be a powerful teaching method for students, but that it can also be a powerful learning method for faculty, if we are willing to invest the time to make it so.
